name: Micron Tongluo fab, Miaoli
summary: The former PSMC P5 wafer fab in Tongluo, Miaoli County, Taiwan, which Micron agreed in January 2026 to buy for $1.8 billion in cash and took over in March 2026. Micron is refitting its roughly 300,000 square feet of 300 mm cleanroom for leading-edge DRAM, including HBM, as an extension of its Taichung operations about 15 miles away, and has started building a second cleanroom of similar size. Its latest filing expects meaningful shipments from the existing fab from mid-calendar 2027.

location.note: About 15 miles from Micron's Taichung campus.

metrics.note: Total cash consideration for the existing fab; later spending on tools and the second cleanroom is not included.
Existing 300 mm cleanroom acquired from PSMC.
Cleanroom to be added by a second facility of comparable scale.

milestones.note: Exclusive letter of intent to buy the site from PSMC.
Refit of the existing cleanroom was due to begin in March 2026.
The filing reports construction under way; the March 2026 release had targeted a start by the end of Micron's fiscal 2026.
January 2026 plan for meaningful DRAM wafer output.
Latest target: meaningful product shipments from the existing fab from mid-calendar 2027 (fiscal 2028 in the March 2026 release).

notes: Recorded under Micron as the current operator. The fab's earlier history under PSMC, which built and opened it, is in the PSMC Tongluo P5 record. Micron's January 2026 release says PSMC will move its own Tongluo operations out over an agreed period.
